group.name: tgsignals – US500
group.description: A small public tgsignals feed for the S&P 500 (US500). The channel describes algorithmic calls for the New York session that can be auto-traded on the subscriber's own MT4 or MT5 account. tgsignals.com says it posts about 1–2 times a week.
